entry_points.summary: Appends structured JSON event to run events.jsonl and repo-wide metrics.jsonl; flock-safe.
Sugar over log-event.sh; start/end/wrap modes emit <phase>_start/_end with wall_ms.
Scans docs/llm/*.json, collects memories[], writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically.
Emits JSON blob with plugin git SHA, dirty flag, branch, optional tag.
Gate script for memory-review agent; <RUN> <parent_command>; 4-state terminal taxonomy; 5-line stdout contract on ready.
CLI: extracts dismissed finding signatures from consecutive archive run pairs; --global and --filename flags; outputs {signatures,n_runs_scanned}.
Pairwise algorithm: R_i snapshot vs R_{i+1}.previous-* user-edited copy to find dismissed findings.
Rsync local tree to ~/dev/qt-bot-sandbox/<slug>/<task-id>/ on remote host; invoked by remote-runner agent.
Layered TOML config loader (slice 1: notify.level, docs.always_apply); deep docs in config-design concept.
Thin shell wrapper: exec python3 scripts/config.py "$@"; deep docs in config-design concept.
End-to-end smoke tests for config.py using hermetic XDG_CONFIG_HOME temp dirs; deep docs in config-design concept.
CLI: walks archive runs, classifies ground truth per rubric_version 1, majority-votes probe, emits calibration-epoch-<N>.json; tripwires exit 1.
Rubric v1: HEAVY if escalation_* event or tasks_total>=16; LIGHT if tasks_total<=5 AND high==0 AND no plan_route_decision; MEDIUM otherwise.
Normative rubric reference; wins over Python impl on conflict; defines HEAVY/LIGHT/MEDIUM rules, tie-break priority, epoch versioning.
Unit test runner for scope-probe-calibrate.py; 6 test suites; importlib load bypasses hyphenated filename; exit 0 pass, 1 fail.

invariants: All scripts require python3 for JSON handling, timing fallbacks, and document generation.
All scripts resolve the repo root via git rev-parse or pwd fallback.
log-event.sh and log-phase.sh honor Z_HARNESS_SLUG for slug-namespaced vs. legacy flat plan layout.
log-event.sh sources scripts/plan-path.sh for canonical and legacy plan path resolution.
regenerate-memories-flat.py writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically via os.replace on a temp file.
run-memory-review.sh always exits 0; skip conditions are communicated via STATUS: line on stdout.
run-memory-review.sh accepts exactly two positional args: <RUN> <parent_command>.

run-memory-review.sh stdout line 1 is always STATUS: ready | STATUS: skipped <reason>; lines 2-4 are diff, SPEC (or empty), TAGS paths when ready; line 5 is DEBUG.md path when parent_command is debug.

run-memory-review.sh emits exactly one memory_review_terminal event on all skip paths using a 4-state taxonomy: skipped_broken_context, not_applicable, ready (orchestrator-owned), dispatched (orchestrator-owned).
extract-dismissals.py outputs JSON {signatures, n_runs_scanned} to stdout; exit 0 even when no dismissals found.
extract-dismissals.py --global applies the pairwise algorithm within each slug independently, not across slugs.
The env var for the plan base dir is Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR (singular, not PLANS_DIR).
scope-probe-calibrate.py exits 0 when no tripwires fire; exits 1 when at least one tripwire fires.
scope-probe-calibrate.py epoch JSON files are written atomically via temp-file replace and are append-only after creation.
CALIBRATION.md is the normative rubric reference; when it conflicts with the Python implementation, CALIBRATION.md wins.
test-scope-probe-calibrate.py loads scope-probe-calibrate.py via importlib.util because the hyphenated filename prevents plain import.
gotchas: run-memory-review.sh 4-state terminal taxonomy: skipped_broken_context (missing_args, no_plan_dir, tags_missing), not_applicable (empty_diff, all_tasks_skipped, debug_md_missing), ready and dispatched are orchestrator-owned.
run-memory-review.sh parent_command=debug adds a third skip condition: STATUS: skipped debug_md_missing if DEBUG.md is absent or unreadable; emits state not_applicable.
run-memory-review.sh _build_terminal_payload has a pure-bash JSON fallback for environments without python3.
macOS BSD date lacks %3N support; log-phase.sh falls back to python3 time.time()*1000.
log-event.sh silently wraps non-JSON payloads as {"raw": ...} instead of failing.
log-event.sh mid-flight legacy detection: writes to old flat path if run dir already exists there.
run-memory-review.sh disables pipefail around git diff | head -n 5000 to tolerate SIGPIPE.
version.sh degrades gracefully if plugin root is not a git repo, returning non-git sentinel values.
extract-dismissals.py drops findings lacking a title field; does NOT fall back to T-MR-NNN ids (renumbered each run).
extract-dismissals.py --filename allows targeting PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md instead of the default MR-REVIEW.md.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh warns but does not fail when no .z-harness-rsync-exclude is found.
config.py, config.sh, and test_config.py are cross-referenced here; invariants and deep gotchas live in the config-design concept.
scope-probe-calibrate.py dispatch_scope_probe_stub always returns MEDIUM (placeholder until T014); normal-mode accuracy results are not meaningful yet.
scope-probe-calibrate.py fixture format: flat {run_id->mode}, nested {run_id->[modes]} (index wrapped), or bare string; absent run_id defaults to MEDIUM.
rubric_version bump invalidates all prior epoch trend comparisons; the calibration epoch series must restart at 1 after a bump.
Tripwire 1 fires at pct_medium >= 70%; Tripwire 2 fires at pct_heavy < 20%; Tripwires 3 and 4 are manual-review-only and never auto-fire.
scope-probe-calibrate.py exits 0 (not 1) when no runs with manifest.json are found — treated as vacuous success, not failure.
